remarks: Beautifully renovated 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath condominium located in the heart of Norwalk. This move-in ready unit features a brand-new kitchen with updated cabinetry, appliances, modern finishes, and spacious living/dining areas filled with natural light. Additional upgrades include new laminate flooring throughout, renovated bathrooms, and fresh contemporary touches that make this home feel like new. Conveniently located close to shopping, restaurants, major highways, Metro-North train stations, and all that Norwalk has to offer. Ideal opportunity for owner-occupants or investors seeking a turnkey property in a desirable location. HOA includes grounds maintenance and common area upkeep. A must-see unit offering comfort, convenience, and value.
